faq.title: Quick answers
faq.payoutAnswer: Buyers pay into the payment partner’s collection account. After the 7-day return period, the partner pays you in the weekly payout, minus marketplace fees and any withheld tax. {name} never holds the money.
faq.taxAnswer: Companies file their own taxes. For household and individual businesses, the marketplace withholds VAT and personal income tax when paying out and issues a withholding certificate (Decree 117/2025/ND-CP — check the original text).
faq.codAnswer: The courier collects on delivery and remits to the partner’s collection account, not the marketplace’s; you are then paid like a prepaid order.
faq.dispute: What if there is a dispute?
faq.disputeAnswer: You have 48 hours to answer the buyer. If you cannot agree, the marketplace decides based on photos, both sides’ statements and the order history.
